items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: In Kansas City, you had a feud with Duke, didn't you? ... INTERVIEWEE: A feud? Wait a minute. Wait what? That's the same as getting in the ring with Louis.

ctx.x: My favorite love song is something that was written by Ellington, called Warm Valley. "That you play now," (Inaudible) Well, we've got it in the book.
It's merely for a feeling which I love,
